title: Structured literature search diagnostics
description: Changes arc_search_literature from a flat candidate list to a structured retrieval object with accepted, rejected, uncertain, diagnostics, and retrieved_by edges, while preserving an output_format=array compatibility mode.
changes: Add lightweight relevance scoring based on title, abstract, metadata, and version-only mismatch detection.
Return diagnostics with raw_count, accepted_count, rejected_count, uncertain_count, sources, and failure_mode.
Append best-effort search_diagnostics.jsonl and queries.jsonl records in the current workspace.
Emit retrieved_by graph edges for accepted papers.

rollback.notes: Restore flat array output without diagnostic buckets.
